citation: 1840 U.S. Census, Chicago, Cook County, Illinois — recovered v4 resident/census adjudication linking census rows to IPUMS SERIALs and selected 1835 identities.
note: Recovered from Chicago_1835_Best_Resident_Set_Research_v4.xlsx. The workbook reviewed 210 named heads on printed pages 229–235 and carried 117 row-to-SERIAL assignments in the best-resident set. Only independently adjudicated identity bridges are attached to canonical 1835 residents; 1840 household composition remains later evidence and is not back-projected to 1835.
